name: sharpps-sitecore
description: Sitecore/SXA knowledge for solutions built on the SharpPS framework: instance interaction via SharpPS.Shells (PowerShell/SPE), SXA native search (/sxa/search/*), creating Feature/Foundation projects, building Controller Renderings with a custom .cshtml view path, converting hardcoded HTML into a Sitecore-driven datasource, and authoring/wiring C# processors into Sitecore's own native CorePipeline engine.
